page_title: EMP 1-0 COM | Empoli v Como 04/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: Van der Brempt I. Muscle Injury

commentary.text: 90+4' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+1' Patrick Cutrone (Como) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he slams his shot well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
90+1' Marco Di Bello shows the yellow card to Liberato Cacace (Empoli) for a heavy challenge.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Patrick Cutrone (Como) passes the ball onto Alberto Cerri, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
88' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.

87' Alberto Cerri (Como) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the bottom left corner. However, but he couldn't beat Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
86' Cesc Fabregas prepares a substitution. Lucas Da Cunha is replaced by Alberto Cerri (Como).
84' Roberto D'Aversa decides to make a substitution. Giuseppe Pezzella will be replaced by Liberato Cacace (Empoli).
84' The substitution is prepared. Luca Marianucci (Empoli) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Liam Henderson.
83' Patrick Cutrone (Como) is penalised for a foul. Marco Di Bello had a clear view and blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Empoli.
82' Nico Paz (Como) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.

81' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. Como have been awarded a corner kick.
81' Como take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

81' Simone Verdi (Como) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. The linesman points to the corner flag, Como are going to take it.
79' Emmanuel Ekong (Empoli) rounds the keeper but the angle is just too hard to find the net. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
78' Andrea Belotti will be replaced by Alessandro Gabrielloni (Como).
78' Cesc Fabregas has decided to make a change. Simone Verdi (Como) replaces Alieu Fadera.
76' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Emmanuel Ekong (Empoli) replacing Pietro Pellegri.
76' We are about to witness a subsitution. Faustino Anjorin (Empoli) for Nicolas Haas.

75' What a great effort! Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the left post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
74' Liam Henderson (Empoli) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
73' Marco Di Bello interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Lucas Da Cunha (Como). Empoli earn a free kick.

71' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
68' Pietro Pellegri (Empoli) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
68' A player from Empoli commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
67' The referee points to the corner flag and Empoli will take a corner.

67' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) gets to the rebound on the edge of the penalty area and fires a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Pepe Reina gets a hand to it and keeps it out. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Empoli.
66' Liam Henderson (Empoli) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
65' The free kick is delivered by Liam Henderson (Empoli) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared. The ball is out of play and Empoli manage to earn a corner.
64' Nico Paz (Como) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Marco Di Bello signals.
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) comes onto the pitch so that Ola Solbakken can be given a rest.
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Patrick Cutrone (Como) will replace Gabriel Strefezza.
62' Here is a change. Federico Barba is going off and Cesc Fabregas gives the last tactical orders to Nico Paz (Como).

60' Mattia De Sciglio (Empoli) controls a neat pass and has options, but decides to shoot from distance. The ball flies towards the bottom right corner, but Pepe Reina is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
58' Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
58' A player from Como commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
57' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Como.
55' Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target. Como win a corner.
54' Empoli take a short corner kick.

54' The ball is crossed into the box and Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) reacts quickest to send a shot flying towards the bottom right corner, but Pepe Reina gets a glove on it to thwart him. The referee signals a corner kick to Empoli.
53' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli). Marco Di Bello saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
51' Andrea Belotti (Como) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach intercepts the ball.
49' The linesman signals that Alieu Fadera (Como) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

48' Alieu Fadera (Como) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball into the middle of the target, but was denied by a great save.
47' 1 - 0 Goal! Pietro Pellegri (Empoli) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the left post. He makes it 1:0.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Andrea Belotti (Como) is able to continue to play.
45+1' Andrea Belotti (Como) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
43' Alberto Moreno (Como) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
41' Wonderful movement by Como. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
39' The corner from Lucas Da Cunha (Como) is cleared away by the defence.
39' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. Como will take a corner kick.
38' Andrea Belotti (Como) jumps for a header from the resulting corner kick and sends the ball in on goal, but the goalkeeper makes a very good save.
37' The referee blows his whistle, Como are awarded a corner kick.
37' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Alieu Fadera (Como) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Como.
37' Ola Solbakken (Empoli) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
33' Yannik Engelhardt (Como) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
32' Yannik Engelhardt (Como) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
31' Marco Di Bello blows his whistle for a foul after Liam Henderson (Empoli) hacks down one of his opponents.
30' Ola Solbakken (Empoli) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
28' Liam Henderson (Empoli) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
28' Alberto Dossena (Como) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Marco Di Bello blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Empoli.
28' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
26' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
26' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
26' The ball goes out of play. Como are awarded a corner kick.
24' Alieu Fadera (Como) plays a through ball but overhits it.
21' A cross from Liam Henderson (Empoli) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. It's a throw-in for Empoli.
21' Edoardo Goldaniga (Como) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. It's a free kick to Empoli in a dangerous position.
20' Mattia Viti (Empoli) brings his opponent down. Marco Di Bello has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
17' The free kick into the penalty area from Liam Henderson (Empoli) is cleared.
17' Yannik Engelhardt (Como) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
16' A pass by Ardian Ismajli (Empoli) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is behind the touchline and Empoli will take a throw-in.
14' Ardian Ismajli (Empoli) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Marco Di Bello blows his whistle for a foul.
13' Mattia Viti (Empoli) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
10' Ola Solbakken (Empoli) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.

9' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Marco Di Bello blows his whistle for an infringement. Como win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
9' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) tries to find Pietro Pellegri, but he puts too much power on the through ball.

5' Andrea Belotti (Como) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Empoli.
4' Empoli are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
1' Alieu Fadera (Como) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Como will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Marco Di Bello.
